suspicion.usage: 记：su-(下面)+spic(看)+-ion(名词后缀)→由下向上打量→怀疑；[近]distrust/doubt n.怀疑；with suspicion 怀疑地；词根:sus(under在下面)+pic(look看)+ion→暗中观察→怀疑；索引p417

ex.en: Ms Brooks may or may not have had suspicions about how her journalists got their stories, but she asked no questions, gave no instructions—nor received traceable, recorded answers.
ex.zh: 很难说布鲁克斯女士是否曾怀疑过她的记者们是如何获取新闻报道的内容的，但是她从来都不过问，也没有作出任何指示——更没有收到过可追踪、有记录可查的答复。

ex.en: His refusal to answer simple questions only deepened the police's suspicion.
ex.zh: 他拒答简单问题的态度反而加深了警方的怀疑。

suspicious.usage: suspicion n. 怀疑；嫌疑；记：由下向上看、上下打量→怀疑的；[族]suspiciously ad.怀疑地；[近]sceptical a.怀疑的；adj.感觉可疑的，怀疑的；索引p417

ex.en: Police are not treating the fire as suspicious.
ex.zh: 警方认为这场火灾没有可疑之处。

ex.en: A few premiers are suspicious of any federal-provincial deal-making.
ex.zh: 一些省份的省长对于联邦政府和各省之间的任何合作都持怀疑的态度。

senses: adv. 怀疑地,有疑心地,令人怀疑地,形迹(或神色等)可疑地
adv. 以怀疑的态度;不信任地

ex.en: The customs officer eyed the sealed carton suspiciously and asked the traveller to open it.
ex.zh: 海关官员狐疑地打量着封好的纸箱，要求旅客把它打开。

senses: vt. 支撑；承受住；遭受；经受
sustain.usage: sus（从下面）+tain（拿住）→从下撑住→支撑。族：sustainable a. 可持续的；记：sus-（下）+tain（握）→握住下面使某物撑住→支撑；同义②stand,support,bear③maintain,keep；adj.持续的，持久的；sus（表示“下面”）+tain（拿）→从下面拿着→使稳固，引申为

ex.en: When she lost her job they could no longer sustain their expensive lifestyle.
ex.zh: 当她失业后，他们再也无法维持他们昂贵的生活方式。

ex.en: A "town of culture" could be not just about the arts but about honouring a town's peculiarities—helping sustain its high street, supporting local facilities and above all celebrating its people.
ex.zh: "文化小镇"可能不只是与艺术有关，还与彰显一个小镇的特质相关——帮助维持其商业街的运营，支持当地设施建设，最重要的是赞美其居民。

ex.en: The soil in the region is too poor to sustain intensive farming for more than a few years.
ex.zh: 该地区的土壤过于贫瘠，集约化耕作维持不了几年。

sustainability.usage: n.持续性，能维持性；sustain 的派生词；索引p417

ex.en: Sustainability is becoming a necessity.
ex.zh: 可持续性正成为一种必需。

ex.en: She exhibits the idealism common to many advocates of sustainability, be it in food or in energy.
ex.zh: 无论是在食品领域还是在能源领域，她展现了许多可持续发展倡导者所共有的理想。

ex.en: Consumers are willing to pay more for products that promote sustainability.
ex.zh: 消费者愿意为促进可持续性的产品支付更高的价格。

senses: a. 可持续的；不破坏生态的
a. 可持续的；不破坏生态平衡的，合理利用的
adj. 可持续的;能长期维持的
sustainable.usage: [族] sustain vt. 维持；sustain 的派生词；adj.可持续的，持续性的；站得 住脚的；词根记忆:sus(under,下面)+tain(hold,支撑)+able(…的)→在下面支撑很久的→可持续的；索引p417

ex.en: They do not provide a sustainable energy supply.
ex.zh: 它们不能提供可持续的能源供应。

ex.en: Cities are redesigning transport systems to make daily travel cheaper and more sustainable.
ex.zh: 各城市正在重新设计交通系统，使日常出行更便宜、更可持续。

ex.en: Critics doubt whether the project's business model is sustainable once public funding ends.
ex.zh: 批评者怀疑，一旦公共资金停止，该项目的商业模式是否还能持续。

ex.en: The timber is harvested sustainably, so no more trees are felled each year than the forest can regrow.
ex.zh: 木材以可持续方式采伐，每年砍伐量不超过森林的再生量。

swallow.usage: s（联想成“蛇”）+wal（联想成wall“墙”）+low（低的）→在低矮的墙上有一条蛇，它想要“吞下”那些“燕子”。；索引p417

ex.en: The pills should be swallowed whole.
ex.zh: 这些药要吞服。

ex.en: She swallowed the professor's claims without asking for a single piece of evidence.
ex.zh: 她对教授的说法照单全收，没有要求任何证据。

ex.en: He swallowed hard before stepping onto the stage.
ex.zh: 上台之前，他紧张地咽了口唾沫。

swamp.usage: 近义：flood vt. 淹没；索引p417

ex.en: Much of the land was once a vast swamp.
ex.zh: 这片土地的很大一部分曾是一片广阔的沼泽。

ex.en: Heavy rains swamped the coastal towns and cut off the main road.
ex.zh: 大雨淹没了沿海城镇，切断了主干道。

ex.en: Officials were swamped with complaints after the price rise.
ex.zh: 提价后，官员们被大量投诉弄得应接不暇。

ex.en: A solitary swan glided across the misty lake at dawn.
ex.zh: 黎明时分，一只孤独的天鹅滑过雾蒙蒙的湖面。

senses: n. 交换;交换物,被掉换者
v. 交换(工作);用……替换,把……换成,掉换(过来)

ex.en: More universities now let students swap one lecture course for a term-long work placement.
ex.zh: 现在越来越多大学允许学生把一门课程换成一学期的实习。

senses: n. 一大群,一大批;(pl.)(of)许多,大量
n. 一大群（蜜蜂等昆虫）
swarm.usage: 同义②cluster,crowd;assemble,gather；很多小虫（worm）成群地来回移动（swarm）。

ex.en: Tourists were swarming all over the island.
ex.zh: 岛上到处是旅游者熙来攘往。

ex.en: A swarm of bees settled in the garden and had to be removed.
ex.zh: 一群蜜蜂落在了花园里，不得不被移走。

ex.en: Reporters swarmed around the minister as she left the building.
ex.zh: 部长离开大楼时，记者们一拥而上围住她。

senses: (亦作swathe) n. [C] (尤指割去植物或庄稼后的)一长条田地；一长条；一长片

ex.en: The hurricane cut a wide swath of destruction along the coast, flattening homes and power lines.
ex.zh: 飓风在沿海造成大范围破坏，夷平房屋，刮断电线。

senses: v. 动摇,影响或改变看法
v. 摇摆，摇动；说服；使动摇
sway.usage: swing 的近义词；s(蛇)+way(路)→蛇在路上爬行左右摇摆→摇摆；索引p417

ex.en: The branches were swaying in the wind.
ex.zh: 树枝在风中摇曳。

ex.en: Voters may be swayed by emotional speeches rather than solid evidence.
ex.zh: 选民可能被煽情的演讲而非确凿的证据所左右。

ex.en: The tall building swayed slightly in the strong wind, but no damage was reported.
ex.zh: 高楼在大风中微微晃动，但没有损坏的报告。

senses: v. 宣誓，发誓；咒骂，诅咒；郑重承诺
swear.usage: swear in 使宣誓就职(常用被动);同义①pledge,promise②curse；在法院上宣誓(swear)时，应当注意自己的穿着(wear)

ex.en: She made him swear not to tell anyone.
ex.zh: 她要他发誓不告诉任何人。

ex.en: The witness swore to tell the truth in court.
ex.zh: 证人在法庭上宣誓说真话。

ex.en: He was fired for swearing at a customer.
ex.zh: 他因对顾客骂人而遭解雇。

sweat.usage: 以后的甜蜜（sweet）就是今天的汗水（sweat）换来的。

ex.en: Their bodies were soaked in sweat.
ex.zh: 他们的身体被汗水浸湿了。

ex.en: The workers sweated in the summer heat to finish the harvest.
ex.zh: 工人们在夏日酷热中挥汗抢收庄稼。

ex.en: Years of sweat went into building the family business.
ex.zh: 家族企业的建立凝聚了多年的辛勤汗水。

ex.en: She folded the hand-knitted sweater carefully and packed it away for winter.
ex.zh: 她小心翼翼地叠好那件手织毛衣，收起来留待冬天穿。

ex.en: Sweden recycles so much household waste that it imports rubbish from abroad to fuel its power plants.
ex.zh: 瑞典的家庭垃圾回收量极大，甚至需要从国外进口垃圾为电厂提供燃料。

senses: v. 打扫，清扫；掠过；席卷，迅速传播
sweep.usage: 派生 sweeper n. 清洁工,清扫器；她不想打扫(sweep)卫生，坐在角落里哭(weep)了

ex.en: Rumours of his resignation swept through the company.
ex.zh: 他辞职的传言在全公司传播开了。

ex.en: She swept the kitchen floor after breakfast.
ex.zh: 早餐后她扫了厨房的地板。

ex.en: The epidemic swept across the continent within a few months.
ex.zh: 疫情在几个月内席卷了整个大陆。

senses: adj. 一概而论的；影响广泛的

ex.en: The government announced sweeping reforms of the tax system, the most radical in half a century.
ex.zh: 政府宣布对税收制度进行全面改革，这是半个世纪以来最激进的改革。

ex.en: Doctors link excessive consumption of sweet drinks to the rise in childhood obesity.
ex.zh: 医生认为，过量饮用甜饮料与儿童肥胖率上升有关。

senses: vi. 膨胀 vt.&vi. （使）凸出；（使）增加
n. 海浪的涌动；隆起处；增加
v. 肿胀，隆起；增加；使凸出，鼓出
swell.usage: 同义expand,inflate,bulge;反义shrink v.收缩,皱缩；他掉到井(well)里很久没人救，腿在水里都泡肿(swell)了；索引p417

ex.en: The river was swollen with melted snow.
ex.zh: 积雪融化，河水上涨。

ex.en: Music swelled from the hall as the ceremony began.
ex.zh: 典礼开始时，音乐声在大厅里渐渐高昂。

ex.en: The number of students choosing online courses continues to swell.
ex.zh: 选择在线课程的学生人数持续增加。

ex.en: The government promised a swift response to the flooding that left thousands homeless.
ex.zh: 政府承诺对使数千人无家可归的洪灾迅速作出反应。

phrases.m: 了解或介入(不了解或不介入)当前情况

ex.en: It is unsafe to swim in the reservoir because of strong undercurrents.
ex.zh: 由于水中有强暗流，在这个水库里游泳并不安全。

ex.en: Doctors recommend swimming for older patients because it strengthens muscles without straining the joints.
ex.zh: 医生向老年患者推荐游泳，因为它能增强肌肉而不损伤关节。

senses: n. 猪;讨厌鬼;下流坯;讨厌的人

ex.en: The outbreak of swine flu in 2009 spread around the globe within weeks, forcing emergency health measures.
ex.zh: 2009年猪流感疫情数周内席卷全球，迫使各国采取紧急卫生措施。

senses: v. (swung,swung)摇摆;转动,转身;剧变,大变
swing.usage: 过去式/过去分词 swung。近义：sway v. 摇摆；坐在秋千(swing)上摇摆，就像长了翅膀(wing)一样

ex.en: We swing on the swings together.
ex.zh: 我们一起荡秋千。

ex.en: The door swung open in the strong wind.
ex.zh: 大风吹得门敞开了。

ex.en: Public opinion swung against the government after the scandal.
ex.zh: 丑闻发生后，公众舆论转向反对政府。

senses: n. 改变,转变;转换;枝条,鞭子

phrases.m: 在 A 和 B 之间转换

switch.usage: 搭配：switch (over) to... 转到…… 近义：shift v./n. 转变；n.开关；骤变，突变 v.打开，关闭；改变，转变；交 换；拓展: switch on 开启，接通(=turn on)；switch off 切断，关掉(=turn off)；索引p417

ex.en: When our brains switch between being focused and unfocused on a task, they tend to be more efficient.
ex.zh: 当我们的大脑就某项工作在专注和分心两种状态之间转换时，它们往往会更加高效。

ex.en: But switching to a mainly plant-based diet wouldn't help.
ex.zh: 但转向以农作物为主的饮食不会有帮助。

ex.en: The factory switched to producing electric bicycles when demand for traditional models collapsed.
ex.zh: 当传统车型的需求骤降时，工厂转产电动自行车。

ex.en: In Switzerland, citizens can challenge almost any new law through a national vote.
ex.zh: 在瑞士，公民几乎可以通过全民投票挑战任何新法律。

senses: adj. 肿胀的,肿起来的;涨水的;上涨的

ex.en: Rescuers could not cross the swollen river, leaving the flooded village cut off for a second day.
ex.zh: 河水暴涨，救援人员无法渡河，被淹村庄已与外界隔绝第二天。

ex.en: In medieval Europe, a sword was often a symbol of rank as much as a weapon.
ex.zh: 在中世纪的欧洲，剑常常既是武器，也是地位的象征。

ex.en: Scientists admire the near-perfect symmetry of snowflakes, each crystal mirroring the others in its structure.
ex.zh: 科学家赞叹雪花近乎完美的对称——每片晶体的结构各部分彼此映照。

senses: n. 符号，代号，记号；象征
symbol.usage: n.象征，标志；符号；sym（同样的）+bol（发音类似 ball 球）→在相同的球上做一样的符号，便于找到它们→符号

ex.en: A list of symbols used on the map is given in the index.
ex.zh: 这份地图所使用的符号全部列在索引中。

ex.en: The dove is widely regarded as a symbol of peace.
ex.zh: 鸽子被广泛视为和平的象征。

ex.en: On this map, a red triangle is the symbol for a historic site.
ex.zh: 在这幅地图上，红色三角形是历史遗迹的符号。

senses: adj. 使用象征的,作为象征的,象征性的
adj. 象征性的；作为象征的
adj. 用作象征的；有象征意义的
symbolic.usage: adj.用作象征的；象征性的；索引p417

ex.en: Symbolic of national unity as they claim to be, their very history—and sometimes the way they behave today—embodies outdated and indefensible privileges and inequalities.
ex.zh: 尽管他们声称自己是国家统一的象征，但他们的历史——以及他们目前有时候的行为方式——体现了过时而站不住脚的特权和不对等。

ex.en: The award is symbolic of her decades of devotion to medical research.
ex.zh: 该奖项象征着她数十年来对医学研究的执着投入。

ex.en: The reopening of the old railway is highly symbolic for the town's revival.
ex.zh: 老铁路的重新通车对这座城镇的复兴具有很强的象征意义。

ex.en: The president symbolically reopened the old bridge, a century after it was first built.
ex.zh: 总统为古桥主持重开仪式，象征性地纪念其建成一百周年。

ex.en: The olive branch has symbolised peace since ancient times and still appears on flags and coins today.
ex.zh: 橄榄枝自古象征和平，如今仍出现在旗帜与硬币之上。

ex.en: Blue, with its intimations of the Virgin Mary, constancy and faithfulness, symbolised femininity.
ex.zh: 蓝色暗指圣母玛利亚，代表专一和忠实，象征了女性气质。

senses: n. 相等,相当,相似,相仿

ex.en: The architect prized symmetry, mirroring the two wings of the building on either side of the hall.
ex.zh: 这位建筑师崇尚对称，将大楼的两翼设计成大厅两侧的镜像。

senses: adj. 出于同情的,同情的
adj. 赞同的,支持的,讨人喜欢的
adj. 同情的，有同情心的；赞同的；支持的；让人喜欢的
sympathetic.usage: adj.同情的；赞同的；讨人喜 欢的；adj.同情的；赞同的；讨人喜欢 的；索引p418

ex.en: The guilt-prone ones share more, even though they hadn't magically become more sympathetic to the other child's deprivation.
ex.zh: 容易感到内疚的孩子会分享更多，虽然他们并没有魔法般地变得更加同情对方的贫乏。

ex.en: The judge was sympathetic to the defendant's difficult childhood but still imposed a heavy fine.
ex.zh: 法官对被告艰难的童年深表同情，但仍课以重罚。

ex.en: Voters are more sympathetic to tax rises when the money clearly funds popular services.
ex.zh: 当资金明确用于受欢迎的公共服务时，选民对增税更为支持。

ex.en: Don't always rely on others to understand and sympathise.
ex.zh: 不要老是指望别人的理解和同情。

ex.en: Readers readily sympathize with the novel's hero, a migrant struggling to build a life in a strange city.
ex.zh: 读者很容易对小说主人公产生共鸣——他是一个在陌生城市挣扎立足的外来者。

ex.en: Doctors who sympathise with their patients' fears tend to explain treatment options far more clearly.
ex.zh: 体谅患者恐惧的医生往往会把治疗方案解释得清楚得多。

senses: n. 同情；赞同，支持；意气相投；志同道合
sympathy.usage: 反义：antipathy n. 憎恶,反感；n.同情，理解；赞同，支持；n.同情；赞同，支持；共鸣 Tom 可以juggle 不同的item，这是他leisure 时间的爱好。有人认为这样很juvenile，但他认为这说明他 成年却仍然保持innocent。没有娱乐的人生是incomplete 的。；sym（同样的）+

ex.en: Mental health allows us to view others with sympathy if they are having troubles, with kindness if they are in pain.
ex.zh: 心理健康使我们在他人遇到麻烦时心怀同情，在他人遭遇痛苦时善意相待。

ex.en: In a number of studies, Malti and others have shown that guilt and sympathy may represent different pathways to cooperation and sharing.
ex.zh: 在大量研究中，马尔蒂和其他人已经证明，内疚和同情可能代表着不同的合作和分享之道。

ex.en: The letter expressed deep sympathy for the families affected by the factory closure.
ex.zh: 这封信对受工厂关闭影响的家庭表达了深切的同情。

symphony.usage: sym（发音类似same“同样的”）+phon（phone声音）+y（名词后缀）→同样的声音→交响乐。；索引p418

ex.en: It's the first performance of the State Symphony Orchestra in the city.
ex.zh: 这是国家交响乐团在该市的首场演出。

ex.en: The young composer's first symphony was performed to great acclaim.
ex.zh: 这位年轻作曲家的第一部交响曲上演后广受好评。

ex.en: Beethoven completed his Ninth Symphony when he was almost completely deaf.
ex.zh: 贝多芬在几乎完全失聪时完成了他的第九交响曲。

senses: n. 讨论会,专题报告会,专题论文集
symposium.usage: 辨析：meeting 一般性会议；assembly 集会；conference 大型正式会议；congress 代表大会；rally 集合；session 一届会议；symposium 学术性专题研讨会

ex.en: The university will host an international symposium on climate adaptation next spring.
ex.zh: 该大学将于明年春天主办一场关于气候适应的国际研讨会。

ex.en: And stay alert to serious symptoms, such as chest pain or pressure, severe shortness of breath or dizziness, or faintness, and seek medical attention immediately.
ex.zh: 要对胸痛、胸闷、严重呼吸急促、头晕、昏厥等严重的症状保持警惕，并立即就医。

ex.en: High staff turnover is often a symptom of deeper problems in how a company treats its workers.
ex.zh: 员工流失率高往往是一个征兆，反映出公司对待员工方式上更深层次的问题。

ex.en: The first symptom of the illness is usually a mild fever that patients easily ignore.
ex.zh: 这种疾病的首个症状通常是被患者轻易忽视的轻微发热。

ex.en: Member institutes meet twice a year to synchronise their research schedules and share the results.
ex.zh: 成员研究所每年会面两次，协调研究日程并共享成果。

ex.en: Chronic fatigue syndrome affects millions of people, yet its causes remain poorly understood.
ex.zh: 慢性疲劳综合征影响着数百万人，但其病因仍不甚明了。

synthesis.usage: 派生 synthesize v. 用合成法制造某物

ex.en: The essay offers a synthesis of economic and psychological accounts of consumer behaviour.
ex.zh: 这篇文章综合了经济学和心理学的观点来解释消费者行为。

senses: adj. 假的,非天然的,虚伪的
adj. 人造的，(人工)合成的
synthetic.usage: syn-(共同)+thet(放)+-ic→放到一起→合成的；[族] synthesis n. 综合；合成；索引p418

ex.en: The jacket is made of synthetic fabric that dries quickly.
ex.zh: 这件夹克由速干的合成面料制成。

ex.en: Scientists have produced synthetic diamonds that are hard to distinguish from natural ones.
ex.zh: 科学家已制造出难以与天然钻石区分的人造钻石。

ex.en: Synthetic materials are widely used in the footwear industry.
ex.zh: 合成材料被广泛应用于制鞋业。

senses: n. [C] 系统；体系；方法；制度；体制；身体

phrases.p: build a new system of financial regulation
phrases.m: 建立新的金融监管体制

ex.en: Children may face serious difficulties in coping with significant moves, especially if it removes them from their current school or support system.
ex.zh: 孩子们在应对重大变迁时可能会面临严重的困难，尤其是如果让他们离开目前就读的学校或保障体系的话。

ex.en: The new railway system will connect the two largest cities in the country.
ex.zh: 新的铁路系统将连接该国最大的两座城市。

ex.en: Regular exercise strengthens the immune system.
ex.zh: 经常锻炼能增强免疫系统。

senses: adj. 有系统的,有规则的,有组织的

phrases.m: adv. 有系统地;有组织地

systematic.usage: 反义systemless adj.无系统的,无规则的；adj.有体系的、系统的；索引p418

ex.en: The police carried out a systematic search of the forest for the missing child.
ex.zh: 警方对森林进行了系统搜查，寻找失踪的孩子。

ex.en: Progress in science depends on systematic observation and careful experiment.
ex.zh: 科学的进步依赖于系统的观察和细致的实验。

ex.en: A systematic approach to learning vocabulary is more effective than memorizing random word lists.
ex.zh: 系统地学习词汇比死记硬背随机词表更有效。

ex.en: Over a decade the archive was systematically catalogued, making every letter searchable online.
ex.zh: 历经十年，档案馆完成了系统编目，如今每封信都可在线检索。

ex.en: The audit praised the systematicness of the laboratory's data-collection procedures.
ex.zh: 审计报告称赞了该实验室数据收集程序的系统性。

senses: adj. 涉及全系统的，系统性的

ex.en: The report argues that systemic failures in financial regulation allowed the crisis to spread so quickly.
ex.zh: 报告认为，金融监管方面的系统性失灵使危机得以如此迅速地蔓延。

ex.en: The bridge is designed to carry lorries weighing up to forty tons.
ex.zh: 这座桥的设计承载量为不超过四十吨的卡车通行。

ex.en: The print on his favourite T-shirt faded after only a few washes.
ex.zh: 他最喜欢的那件T恤才洗了几次，上面的印花就褪色了。

senses: n. 桌子,台子;目录,表格

ex.en: The survey results are summarised in a single table at the end of the report.
ex.zh: 调查结果汇总在报告末尾的一张表格中。

ex.en: The doctor told her to take one tablet after meals, twice a day.
ex.zh: 医生嘱咐她每天服药两次，每次一片，饭后服用。

senses: n. (pl. taboos)(文化或宗教习俗方面的)禁忌,忌讳,戒律;禁止,避讳

ex.en: Discussing salary openly remains a taboo in many traditional workplaces.
ex.zh: 在许多传统职场，公开谈论工资仍是一个禁忌。

ex.en: Please attach a recent photograph to your application form before submitting it.
ex.zh: 提交申请表之前，请在上面贴一张近照。

tackle.usage: 近义：handle vt. 处理，解决；近义：handle vt. 处理；应付；同义deal,handle；v.应付，解决；与……交涉；处 理；抓获；抢断 n.（足球等中的）抢断球；发音类似"太抠"→"应付"太抠的人是很难的→应付；索引p418

ex.en: The government is determined to tackle inflation.
ex.zh: 政府决心解决通货膨胀问题。

ex.en: What is considered a weakness of the city-level measures to tackle dirty air?
ex.zh: 哪项被认为是城市治理空气污染措施的一个不足？

ex.en: Volunteer groups have joined the city's efforts to tackle loneliness among the elderly.
ex.zh: 志愿者团体加入了该市解决老年人孤独问题的行动。

ex.en: Regular contact between managers and frontline staff helps prevent costly misunderstandings.
ex.zh: 管理者与一线员工保持经常接触，有助于避免代价高昂的误解。

tactic.usage: 在战争年代，进攻(attack)想取得成功，是需要战术(tactic)的；索引p418

ex.en: The manager discussed tactics with his team.
ex.zh: 主教练和他的团队讨论了战术。

ex.en: Delaying the negotiation was simply a tactic to gain a better deal.
ex.zh: 推迟谈判只是争取更有利协议的一种策略。

ex.en: Such aggressive sales tactics may drive customers away rather than attract them.
ex.zh: 如此激进的推销手段可能把顾客赶跑，而不是吸引他们。

tag.usage: 近义：label n. 标签；他往tap(水龙头)上贴tag(标签)；发音类似“泰哥”。他有个同事经常喊他“泰哥”，后来我就给他贴了一个“标签”：泰哥。

ex.en: He put name tags on all his shirts.
ex.zh: 他给自己所有的衬衣都缝上了标有姓名的签条。

ex.en: Check the price tag before you take the item to the counter.
ex.zh: 把商品拿到收银台之前先看看价签。

ex.en: All the sheep were tagged so that farmers could track them.
ex.zh: 所有的羊都加挂了标签，以便农民进行追踪。

ex.en: The comet's glowing tail stretched across the night sky for several weeks.
ex.zh: 彗星发光的尾巴在夜空中延展了数周之久。

senses: vt. 缝制;针对特定目的做修改;使适应
tailor.usage: n.裁缝 v.定做；tail（=cut剪，切）+or（表“人”）→裁剪的人→裁缝

ex.en: Special programmes of study are tailored to the needs of specific groups.
ex.zh: 为满足特定群体的需要，特制了专门的课程。

ex.en: The course is tailored to the needs of adult learners.
ex.zh: 这门课程是为成年学习者的需求量身定制的。

ex.en: As a young tailor, he was known for making suits that fit perfectly.
ex.zh: 还是个年轻裁缝时，他就以做出非常合身的西装而闻名。

ex.en: Farmers must maintain the fertility of the soil to secure stable harvests.
ex.zh: 农民必须保持土壤肥力，才能确保收成稳定。

ex.en: The company offers flexible hours in order to retain its most talented employees.
ex.zh: 公司提供弹性工作时间，以便留住最有才能的员工。

senses: vt. 携带；带去；使达到；拿开；误拿；买下；服（药）
v. ①拿取，携带；带去，引领②吃，服用③记录，拍摄
④取得，接受⑤需要，花费⑥捕获，抓住
⑦认为，当做；n. (一次)录音，(一次)拍摄
v. 采取（措施）；需要…时间
take.usage: n. 看法义项真题（2021年阅读）：the latest take of the FCC on net neutrality 联邦通信委员会关于网络中立的最新立场；真题词组还有：take action 采取行动；take effect 起作用；take place 发生；take over 接管；take up 开始

ex.en: Meanwhile, there are steps you can take to help reduce abdominal fat and maintain lean muscle mass as you age in order to protect both your physical and mental wellbeing.
ex.zh: 与此同时，随着年龄的增长，你可以采取一些措施来帮助减少腹部脂肪，维持精瘦肌肉的总量，以此来保持身心健康。

ex.en: The journey takes about two hours by train.
ex.zh: 乘火车去大约需要两个小时。

ex.en: Take this medicine twice a day after meals.
ex.zh: 这种药每天服两次，饭后服用。

ex.en: We ordered a Chinese takeaway and watched the football match on television.
ex.zh: 我们点了中餐外卖，一边看电视上的足球赛。

tale.usage: 辨析:tale虚构演绎结构较松散;story常用词;narrative正式用语;anecdote名人真事趣闻

ex.en: The novel weaves a tale of migration, loss, and unexpected friendship.
ex.zh: 这部小说讲述了一个关于迁徙、失去和意外友谊的故事。

talent.usage: tal(联想tall高)+ent(人)→高人就是有天赋的人；索引p418

ex.en: She displayed her talent for comedy at the event.
ex.zh: 她在活动中展示了自己的喜剧天赋。

ex.en: The company is always searching for young talent in the field of AI.
ex.zh: 该公司一直在寻找人工智能领域的年轻人才。

ex.en: She has a natural talent for explaining complicated ideas in simple words.
ex.zh: 她天生擅长用简单的语言解释复杂的概念。

senses: n. 交谈；讨论；（专题）报告

ex.en: Economists increasingly talk of a soft landing rather than a deep recession.
ex.zh: 经济学家越来越多地谈论经济软着陆，而非深度衰退。

senses: adj. 爱说话的,健谈的;多嘴的

ex.en: My talkative neighbour can turn a two-minute greeting into an hour-long conversation.
ex.zh: 我那位健谈的邻居能把两分钟的寒暄变成一小时的交谈。

ex.en: A tall glass atrium floods the new library's reading rooms with natural light.
ex.zh: 高耸的玻璃中庭让新图书馆的阅览室洒满自然光。

senses: adj. 平淡的,枯燥乏味的
v. 驯化,驯服;控制并利用;控制,抑制
tame.usage: 这个 game(游戏)的内容是 tame(枯燥乏味的)；同义mild,gentle,obedient;反义wild;这个game(游戏)的内容是tame(枯燥乏味的)；ta(她)+me(我)→她和我都是"温顺的"人

ex.en: Lions can never be completely tamed.
ex.zh: 狮子永远不能被完全驯化。

ex.en: The monkeys in the park are quite tame and will eat from your hand.
ex.zh: 公园里的猴子相当温顺，会从你手里吃东西。

ex.en: Critics found the film tame compared with the director's earlier work.
ex.zh: 与导演早期作品相比，评论家们觉得这部电影平淡乏味。

senses: adj. 棕黄色的,棕褐色的

ex.en: He returned from the beach with a deep tan and a renewed sense of energy.
ex.zh: 他从海滩回来，晒得黝黑，精力也恢复了不少。

senses: a. 有形的；实实在在的
adj. 有形的；实实在在的
adj. (常用于名词前)有形的,实际的,真实的
可触摸的,可触知的,可感知的
adj. 有形的；实际的；真实的
tangible.usage: 词根 tang 表示“接触”；与 intangible（无形的）意思相反。；反义intangible adj.无形的;派生tangibly adv.可触摸地；tang（触摸）+ible（形容词后缀）→可以触摸到的→有形的。；索引p418

ex.en: The scheme must have tangible benefits for the unemployed.
ex.zh: 这项计划必须对失业者有切实的好处。

ex.en: The talks produced no tangible results, leaving both sides frustrated.
ex.zh: 会谈没有取得任何实质性成果，令双方都很失望。

ex.en: For many students, a diploma is the most tangible proof of four years' effort.
ex.zh: 对许多学生来说，文凭是四年努力最切实的证明。

senses: v. 绞在一起,(使某物)乱作一团

ex.en: Negotiators had to cut through a legal tangle before the merger could proceed.
ex.zh: 在合并得以推进之前，谈判代表必须理清法律上的一团乱麻。

ex.en: The village stores its drinking water in a large steel tank on the hillside.
ex.zh: 村庄把饮用水储存在山坡上的一个大型钢制水箱里。

ex.en: The oil tanker ran aground near the reef, threatening a protected marine sanctuary.
ex.zh: 油轮在暗礁附近搁浅，威胁到一处受保护的海洋保护区。

senses: n. (水、煤气等管道或容器的)龙头,阀门,塞子(c);轻扣,轻拍(c)
tap.usage: tape(磁带)里有 tap(窃听)的内容；tape(磁带)里有tap(窃听)的内容

ex.en: He heard a soft tap at the window and looked up from his book.
ex.zh: 他听到窗户上轻轻的敲击声，便从书中抬起头来。

ex.en: Investigators sealed the area with warning tape while forensic teams searched for clues.
ex.zh: 调查人员用警戒带封锁了现场，法证人员则搜寻线索。

senses: n. 对象，目标；（射击的）靶子
v. 瞄准；把……作为攻击目标；面向
target.usage: n.目标，指标；靶子 v.把……作为攻击目标；面向；tar（发音类似"他"）+get（获得）→他要获得胜利就得射中"靶子"→靶子；目标；索引p418

ex.en: The target audience for the TV series is young people aged 13 to 18.
ex.zh: 这部电视剧的目标受众是13到18岁的年轻人。

ex.en: Cheap flights deliberately target students, whose travel plans are flexible and price-sensitive.
ex.zh: 廉价航班刻意以学生为目标客群，因为学生旅行时间灵活且对价格敏感。

ex.en: The charity missed its fundraising target this year, largely because of the economic downturn.
ex.zh: 该慈善机构今年未能实现筹款目标，主要原因是经济低迷。

senses: n. 税率,关税;收费(表),(旅馆或饭店等)价目表

ex.en: The new tariff on imported steel is expected to raise costs for domestic manufacturers.
ex.zh: 对进口钢材征收的新关税预计将增加国内制造商的成本。

ex.en: Completing the census proved a formidable task in such a sparsely populated region.
ex.zh: 在人口如此稀少的地区完成人口普查是一项艰巨的任务。

senses: ②体验，感到；n. ①滋味，味觉(c/u)

ex.en: The soup has a slightly bitter taste that many people grow to like.
ex.zh: 这汤略带苦味，许多人渐渐喜欢上了这种味道。

ex.en: The exhibition reflects the changing taste of the art market.
ex.zh: 这场展览反映了艺术品市场品味的变化。

ex.en: She tasted the sauce and added a little more salt.
ex.zh: 她尝了尝酱汁，又加了一点盐。

ex.en: Street food can be both tasty and affordable, which partly explains its enduring popularity.
ex.zh: 街头小吃既美味又实惠，这是它经久不衰的部分原因。

ex.en: The proposed tax on sugary drinks aims to change consumer habits rather than raise revenue.
ex.zh: 拟议的含糖饮料税旨在改变消费者习惯，而非增加财政收入。

ex.en: Ride-hailing apps have sharply reduced the number of passengers hailing a taxi on the street.
ex.zh: 网约车应用大幅减少了在街头扬手招呼出租车的乘客数量。

taxpayer.usage: n.纳税人；taxpayer 由 tax+payer 构成的复合名词。

ex.en: The project wasted taxpayers' money.
ex.zh: 该项目浪费了纳税人的钱。

ex.en: Taxpayers have the right to know how their money is spent.
ex.zh: 纳税人有权知道自己的钱是如何使用的。

ex.en: Critics argue that bailing out failing banks puts an unfair burden on ordinary taxpayers.
ex.zh: 批评者认为，救助濒临倒闭的银行给普通纳税人带来了不公平的负担。

ex.en: Tea cultivation spread along the mountain slopes and transformed the local economy within decades.
ex.zh: 茶叶种植沿山坡蔓延，在几十年间改变了当地经济。

teach.usage: n.教学工作，授课；教义，学说 adj.教学的，与教学有关的

ex.en: Volunteers teach English to children in remote villages every summer.
ex.zh: 志愿者每年夏天在偏远村庄教孩子们英语。

ex.en: The failure taught him to plan more carefully.
ex.zh: 这次失败教会了他更周密地规划。

ex.en: She was hired to teach mathematics at the local high school.
ex.zh: 她受聘在当地中学教数学。

ex.en: An experienced teacher can often spot a struggling reader long before any test does.
ex.zh: 有经验的教师往往能在任何测试之前很久就发现阅读吃力的学生。

senses: n. （游戏或运动的）队；（一起工作的）组，班

ex.en: The research team published its findings in a leading neuroscience journal.
ex.zh: 该研究小组将研究结果发表在一份权威的神经科学期刊上。

ex.en: The teamster left his lorry loaded outside the warehouse overnight by mistake.
ex.zh: 卡车司机一时疏忽，把装了货的货车整夜停在了仓库外。

tear.usage: v.撕裂；撕破；扯掉；拉伤；狂 奔，疾驰 n.泪水；裂口，破洞

ex.en: Be careful not to tear the delicate paper while removing the old poster.
ex.zh: 揭下旧海报时，小心不要撕坏这张脆弱的纸。

senses: vt. 戏弄,取笑;挑逗,撩拨

ex.en: Classmates would tease him about his accent, unaware of how deeply it hurt.
ex.zh: 同学们会取笑他的口音，却不知道这有多伤人。

ex.en: New technology has transformed the way people work, shop and communicate.
ex.zh: 新技术改变了人们工作、购物和交流的方式。

ex.en: The manual is full of technical terms that ordinary readers can hardly understand.
ex.zh: 这本手册满是普通读者难以理解的技术术语。

ex.en: The engineers solved a series of technical problems before the product was launched.
ex.zh: 在产品上市之前，工程师们解决了一系列技术问题。

ex.en: His technical skill is beyond question, but he lacks management experience.
ex.zh: 他的技术能力毋庸置疑，但他缺乏管理经验。

technically.usage: adv.技术上；专门地；学术上； 工艺上

ex.en: Technically, the project is feasible, but it would require a far larger budget than expected.
ex.zh: 从技术上讲，该项目是可行的，但所需的预算会远超预期。

ex.en: A laboratory technician checked the samples twice before the analysis.
ex.zh: 实验室技术员在分析前对样本检查了两遍。

ex.en: The sound technician adjusted the microphones before the concert began.
ex.zh: 音乐会开始前，音响技师调整了麦克风。

ex.en: Skilled technicians are in short supply across the manufacturing industry.
ex.zh: 制造业普遍缺乏熟练技术人员。

ex.en: Critics warn that a purely technicist approach to education ignores the development of creativity.
ex.zh: 批评者警告说，纯粹技术主义的教育方式忽视了创造力的培养。

technique.usage: 辨析:technology是技术、工艺在学术理论上的总称;technique常指某种具体的技术、技艺；n.技巧，手法、技术；索引p418

ex.en: The surgeon is admired for his precise operating technique.
ex.zh: 这位外科医生以精准的手术技术受人敬佩。

ex.en: Modern farming techniques have greatly increased crop yields.
ex.zh: 现代农业技术大大提高了农作物产量。

ex.en: The pianist's technique is flawless, yet her playing lacks emotional depth.
ex.zh: 这位钢琴家的技巧无可挑剔，但演奏缺乏情感深度。

technological.usage: adj.技术上的，工艺（学）的；索引p418

ex.en: Rapid technological change has outrun the laws designed to regulate it.
ex.zh: 迅速的技术变革已经超出了为规范它而制定的法律。

ex.en: New farming technology has raised yields while reducing water consumption.
ex.zh: 新的农业技术在提高产量的同时减少了用水量。

phrases.m: 人工智能图像处理技术

ex.en: Modern technology allows artisans to combine traditional craft with digital design.
ex.zh: 现代科技使工匠能够将传统工艺与数字设计相结合。

ex.en: Thick blinds were fitted to protect the furniture from strong summer sunlight.
ex.zh: 房间里装了厚实的百叶窗，以保护家具免受夏日强烈阳光的损害。

senses: adj. 单调乏味的,冗长的,令人厌倦的
adj. 冗长的，枯燥乏味的
tedious.usage: 同义tiresome,boring,dull;反义interesting;派生tediousness n.沉闷,乏味；t（联想成“提”）+ed（联想成“过去式”）+i（我）+ous（形容词后缀）→妈妈老是在外人面前提我过去的事儿，太单调了→单调的，乏味的。；索引p418

ex.en: The journey soon became tedious.
ex.zh: 那次旅行不久就变得乏味起来。

ex.en: Data entry is a tedious job that requires patience and accuracy.
ex.zh: 数据录入是一份单调乏味的工作，需要耐心和准确。

ex.en: The professor managed to make a tedious topic lively and engaging.
ex.zh: 这位教授设法把一个枯燥的话题讲得生动有趣。

ex.en: Music helped the workers endure the tedium of long hours on the assembly line.
ex.zh: 音乐帮助工人们忍受流水线上长时间工作的单调乏味。

senses: n. 青少年，十几岁的人（指从13到19岁）

ex.en: Sleep researchers found that most teenagers need at least nine hours of sleep a night.
ex.zh: 睡眠研究人员发现，大多数青少年每晚需要至少九小时的睡眠。

ex.en: She left her telephone number at the front desk in case the flight schedule changed.
ex.zh: 她把电话号码留在了前台，以防航班时刻有变。

ex.en: The telecom industry has invested heavily in extending network coverage to rural areas.
ex.zh: 电信行业已投入巨资，将网络覆盖扩展到农村地区。

ex.en: The telecommunication industry has invested billions in building faster wireless networks.
ex.zh: 电信行业已投入数十亿资金建设更快的无线网络。

senses: v. 打电报传达(消息),报告
telegraph.usage: tele(远程)+graph(记录器)→远程记录器→电报机

ex.en: Before the telegraph, news could travel no faster than a horse or a ship.
ex.zh: 在电报出现之前，消息的传播速度不会快于一匹马或一艘船。

ex.en: The survey was conducted by telephone to reach households without internet access.
ex.zh: 这项调查通过电话进行，以便联系到没有互联网的家庭。

telescope.usage: tele(远程)+scope(范围)→能看到远程范围→望远镜;派生telescopic adj.望远镜的；n.望远镜 v.缩短

ex.en: Galileo was the first to point a telescope at the night sky.
ex.zh: 伽利略是第一个把望远镜对准夜空的人。

ex.en: The new space telescope will study planets outside our solar system.
ex.zh: 新的太空望远镜将研究太阳系外的行星。

ex.en: With a small telescope you can see the rings of Saturn.
ex.zh: 用一架小望远镜就能看到土星的光环。

senses: vt. 讲述；表达；告诉；说明；显示；命令；区分

ex.en: Experts can tell genuine paintings from forgeries by examining brushwork and pigments.
ex.zh: 专家可以通过检视笔法和颜料来辨别真迹与赝品。

ex.en: The bank teller noticed something odd about the cheque and quietly called her manager.
ex.zh: 银行出纳发觉那张支票有些异常，便悄悄叫来了经理。

senses: a. 生动的；显露真实面目的；强有力的；显著的

ex.en: The absence of any official response is a telling sign of the government's real attitude.
ex.zh: 官方毫无回应，这一迹象清楚地显露了政府的真实态度。

phrases.m: 耐住性子，不使脾气发作

temper.usage: 记：本身为词根，意为“调节”→调节让情绪平和→使缓和；[族]temperament n.易冲动；[近]mood n.心情；温度temperature一高人的脾气temper也变得暴躁；lose/keep one's temper发脾气/忍住怒火；索引p418

ex.en: Sales have been lagging for months as shoppers temper their spending.
ex.zh: 随着购物者削减开支，销售额几个月来一直在下滑。

ex.en: He apologized for losing his temper at the meeting yesterday.
ex.zh: 他为昨天在会上发脾气而道歉。

ex.en: bad temper
ex.zh: 坏脾气

ex.en: His calm temperament makes him well suited to emergency work.
ex.zh: 他沉着的性格非常适合应急工作。

ex.en: The two sisters differ sharply in temperament.
ex.zh: 姐妹俩的性情截然不同。

ex.en: Breeders select dogs for both health and temperament.
ex.zh: 繁育者在挑选狗时兼顾健康与性情。

ex.en: Even a small rise in global temperature can shift rainfall patterns across entire continents.
ex.zh: 全球气温即使小幅上升，也会改变整个大陆的降水格局。

senses: n. 样板;模板;型板;范本

ex.en: The committee circulated a template so that all project reports follow the same format.
ex.zh: 委员会传发了一份模板，使所有项目报告都采用统一格式。

ex.en: The ancient temple was restored with funds from both the government and private donors.
ex.zh: 这座古庙依靠政府和私人捐助者的资金得到了修复。

ex.en: The annual temple fair attracts thousands of visitors with folk performances and local snacks.
ex.zh: 一年一度的庙会以民俗表演和地方小吃吸引着成千上万的游客。

senses: n. 节奏；行进速度；（音乐的）速度

ex.en: The conductor slowed the tempo to heighten the drama of the finale.
ex.zh: 指挥放慢了节奏，以增强终曲的戏剧效果。

ex.en: Because of the temporary closure of the main road, buses will follow a different route.
ex.zh: 由于主干道临时封闭，公交车将改道行驶。

senses: a. 世间的；世俗的；时间的；太阳穴的
adj. ①世间的，世俗的，现世的

ex.en: The study separates temporal trends from changes caused by a single dramatic event.
ex.zh: 该研究将时间性趋势与单一重大事件引起的变化区分开来。

ex.en: The bridge was temporarily closed after engineers detected cracks in a support pillar.
ex.zh: 工程师发现支撑桥墩出现裂缝后，大桥被暂时关闭。

senses: adj. 暂时的，临时的；短暂的
temporary.usage: tempor（表时间）+ary（形容词后缀）→可持续的时间很短→暂时的，临时的；拓展：temporary guest workers 临时外籍劳工；词根记忆: tempor(时间)+ary(形容词后缀)→有时间限制的→临时的；索引p418

ex.en: The woman needs a temporary replacement for her assistant.
ex.zh: 这名妇女需要一名临时替代者来接替她的助手。

ex.en: The bridge closure is only temporary, and traffic will return to normal within two weeks.
ex.zh: 桥梁封闭只是临时性的，两周内交通将恢复正常。

ex.en: Many graduates accept temporary jobs while searching for permanent positions in their field.
ex.zh: 许多毕业生在寻找本专业固定职位期间会先接受临时工作。

tempt.usage: 记：本身为词根，意为“尝试”→诱导某人尝试做某事→引诱；[族]temptation n.引诱诱惑；[近]lure vt.引诱；发音类似"贪不得"→各种"诱惑，引诱"更是贪不得；辨析: tempt 指吸引力很强，强调欲望被唤醒；索引p418

ex.en: The best lawyers made skyscrapers-full of money, tempting ever more students to pile into law schools.
ex.zh: 最好的律师薪水很高，吸引越来越多的学生进入法学院。

ex.en: The offer of free credit tempted her into buying a new car.
ex.zh: 可享受免费贷款让她禁不住诱惑买了一辆新车。

temptation.usage: 源于 tempt vt. 诱惑。近义：lure n./vt. 诱惑；索引p418

ex.en: He resisted the temptation to check his phone during the exam.
ex.zh: 他抵制住了考试期间看手机的诱惑。

ex.en: The temptation to spend the bonus on a holiday was too strong to resist.
ex.zh: 把奖金花在度假上的诱惑太强，让人难以抗拒。

ex.en: Clever advertising is designed to create temptation rather than meet real needs.
ex.zh: 巧妙的广告旨在制造诱惑，而不是满足真实需求。

ex.en: Nearly ten thousand runners signed up for the city marathon this year.
ex.zh: 今年有近一万人报名参加这座城市举办的马拉松赛。

ex.en: The final report contains several recommendations for improving safety on campus.
ex.zh: 最终报告包含几条改善校园安全的建议。

tenant.usage: ten(十)只ant(蚂蚁)合在一起是tenant(房客);派生tenancy n.租用(期);tenantry n.佃户

ex.en: They had evicted their tenants for non-payment of rent.
ex.zh: 他们赶走了未交房租的房客。

ex.en: The landlord is responsible for repairing the heating in his tenants' flats.
ex.zh: 房东负责修理其租户公寓里的供暖设备。

ex.en: Tenants must give two months' notice before moving out.
ex.zh: 租户搬走前必须提前两个月通知。

tend.usage: 族：tendency n. 倾向；趋势。近义：incline v. 倾向于；索引p418

ex.en: Although American men tend to talk more than women in public situations, they often talk less at home.
ex.zh: 尽管在公众场合美国男性通常比女性健谈，但在家他们一般话比较少。

ex.en: Older workers tend to be more loyal to their employers than younger ones.
ex.zh: 年纪较大的员工往往比年轻员工对雇主更忠诚。

ex.en: Nurses tend to the wounded around the clock in the emergency ward.
ex.zh: 急诊病房里，护士们日夜照料伤员。

ex.en: The company intends to extend its delivery services to smaller cities next year.
ex.zh: 该公司打算明年把配送服务扩展到较小的城市。

tendency.usage: tend 的派生词；tend（趋向）+ency（状态，行为）→趋向，趋势。；索引p418

ex.en: Attempts have been made to curb this tendency.
ex.zh: 为了遏制这种趋势，已经进行了一些尝试。

ex.en: He has a tendency to exaggerate the difficulties he meets.
ex.zh: 他有一种夸大自己所遇困难的倾向。

ex.en: Prices show a tendency to rise during holiday seasons.
ex.zh: 节假日里价格呈上涨趋势。

senses: adj. 温和的,温柔的,慈爱的；易受感动的；敏感的
adj. 嫩的，柔软的；脆弱的；温柔的，亲切的
tender.usage: 助记:lender(借款人)是tender(温和的)男人;派生tenderness n.脆弱,柔软；发音类似“疼的”→别人稍微碰你一下，你就会疼→脆弱的，嫩的。

ex.en: What he needs now is a lot of tender loving care.
ex.zh: 他现在需要的是充分的关心和爱护。

ex.en: The beef is so tender that it falls apart at the touch of a fork.
ex.zh: 这牛肉嫩得一碰叉子就散开。

ex.en: The firm tendered for the contract to build the new hospital.
ex.zh: 该公司投标承建新医院。

ex.en: She credits tennis with teaching her discipline and how to accept defeat gracefully.
ex.zh: 她认为网球教会了她自律，以及如何得体地接受失败。

tense.usage: 派生tensely adv.紧张地;tenseness n.紧张(状态)；ten(十)+se(蛇)：上学路上跑出十条蛇围着你，紧张

ex.en: Older generations often talk about their degree in the present and personal tense.
ex.zh: 老一辈人经常用现在时的和个人化的口吻谈论自己的学位。

ex.en: The players grew tense as the match entered its final minutes.
ex.zh: 比赛进入最后几分钟，球员们变得紧张起来。

ex.en: The situation along the border remains tense despite the peace talks.
ex.zh: 尽管举行了和谈，边境局势依然紧张。

senses: n. [U,C] 紧张局势（或关系、状况）
tension.usage: [族] tense a. 紧张的（链P286）；tens(e)(紧张的)+ion(名词后缀)→紧张；词根记忆：tens(stretch,伸展)+ion(名词后缀)→伸展到极点→张力；索引p418

ex.en: The tension in the room was obvious as the verdict was read out.
ex.zh: 宣读裁决时，房间里的紧张气氛显而易见。

ex.en: Trade disputes have increased tensions between the two countries.
ex.zh: 贸易争端加剧了两国之间的紧张关系。

ex.en: Massage can help relieve the tension in your shoulders and neck.
ex.zh: 按摩有助于缓解肩颈部位的紧绷。

ex.en: The rescue team pitched a tent near the collapsed mine as a temporary command post.
ex.zh: 救援队在坍塌的矿井附近搭起帐篷，作为临时指挥所。

senses: adj. 试验(性)的，试探(性)的，暂时(性)的，(凭)推测的，不确定的

ex.en: The two sides reached a tentative agreement after months of talks.
ex.zh: 经过数月谈判，双方达成了初步协议。

ex.en: She made a tentative suggestion that the deadline be extended.
ex.zh: 她试探性地建议延长截止日期。

ex.en: He gave a tentative smile and sat down at the back of the room.
ex.zh: 他怯生生地笑了笑，在房间后面坐下了。

senses: n. [C,U] 学期 [C] 任期；术语
④术语，专有名词；⑤关系，地位
term.usage: 词组：in terms of/in...terms就…而言、在…方面；come to terms with sth.接受、对…妥协；on good/friendly terms关系好；索引p418

ex.en: More than half of all British scientific research is now published under open access terms.
ex.zh: 现在，英国一半以上的科研成果都在开放获取的条款下出版。

ex.en: The first term of the academic year begins in September.
ex.zh: 学年的第一学期从九月开始。

ex.en: The doctor explained the diagnosis in terms a patient could understand.
ex.zh: 医生用病人能听懂的术语解释了病情。

ex.en: The meeting was terminated early because the main points had already been settled.
ex.zh: 由于主要问题已经解决，会议提前结束了。

senses: n. 终点站；航站楼；终端
adj. 末端的；晚期的；期末的
n. 终点站；终端，终端机；(电路的)端子，线接头
adj. ①患绝症的，晚期的；不治的，致命的
②不可救药的；无可挽回的；③末端的，末梢的
n. 航站楼；航空终点站；（火车、公共汽车或船的）终点站；终端
terminal.usage: n.终点站；航站楼；终端 adj.晚期的；终端的，末 端的；在机场外细心观察一下，很容易看到这个词

ex.en: Flights for Rome depart from Terminal 3.
ex.zh: 飞往罗马的班机从3号航站楼出发。

ex.en: Her illness was terminal, yet she remained optimistic until the end.
ex.zh: 她的病已是晚期，但她始终乐观，直到最后一刻。

ex.en: Passengers can move between the two terminals by a free shuttle bus.
ex.zh: 旅客可以乘坐免费班车在两个航站楼之间往返。

ex.en: You have no right to terminate the contract.
ex.zh: 你无权终止合同。

ex.en: The train service will terminate at the next station because of the storm.
ex.zh: 由于暴风雨，列车将在下一站终止运行。

ex.en: The company terminated his employment after the investigation ended.
ex.zh: 调查结束后，公司解除了他的雇佣关系。

ex.en: Unfair termination of contracts can expose a company to costly litigation.
ex.zh: 不公平的合同终止会让公司面临代价高昂的诉讼。

ex.en: In genetics, a terminator sequence signals the enzyme to stop copying DNA.
ex.zh: 在遗传学中，终止子序列会指示酶停止复制DNA。

ex.en: Legal terminology often confuses readers who lack professional training.
ex.zh: 法律术语常常让缺乏专业训练的读者感到困惑。

ex.en: The expedition mapped a vast territory that had never been properly surveyed before.
ex.zh: 探险队测绘了一片此前从未被认真勘测过的广阔地域。

ex.en: The vehicle was specially designed to cope with rough mountain terrain.
ex.zh: 这种车辆专为应对崎岖的山地地形而设计。

senses: a. 非常讨厌的；令人极不快的；可怕的

ex.en: The drought had a terrible effect on harvests across the entire region.
ex.zh: 这场干旱对整个地区的收成造成了极坏的影响。

senses: adj. 极好的,非常的,极度的
adj. 很强的,很大的,很多的
adj. 极好的，绝妙的，了不起的
adj. 很大的，巨大的；异乎寻常的
terrific.usage: 派生terrifically adv.极度地；他觉得这个想法极好（terrific），但我觉得很可怕（terrible）。；索引p418

ex.en: I've got a terrific amount of work to do.
ex.zh: 我有大量的工作要做。

ex.en: The concert last night was terrific; the audience stood up and cheered.
ex.zh: 昨晚的音乐会精彩极了，观众起立欢呼。

ex.en: She made terrific progress in English after just one year of study.
ex.zh: 仅仅学习一年，她的英语就取得了惊人的进步。

senses: v. 使恐惧，使十分害怕；使惊吓
terrify.usage: 同义frighten,threaten；terri(想成terror恐怖)+fy(动词后缀"使")→使害怕→恐惧，威胁

ex.en: Flying terrifies her.
ex.zh: 她害怕坐飞机。

ex.en: The children were terrified by the thunder and lightning.
ex.zh: 雷电把孩子们吓坏了。

ex.en: The thought of speaking in public terrifies many otherwise confident people.
ex.zh: 一想到当众演讲，许多平日自信的人也会十分恐惧。

ex.en: Passengers described the sudden turbulence as the most terrifying moment of the entire flight.
ex.zh: 乘客们形容那次突如其来的颠簸是整个航程中最可怕的时刻。

territory.usage: 记：terr(陆地)+it+-ory(名后缀)→一国主权管辖的区域→领土；[族]territorial a.领土的；[近]domain n.领地；n.领土，领地；地区；领域；terri（土地）+tory（场所，范围，如factory）→土地的范围→领土，领域；索引p418

ex.en: The explorers set off to conquer new territories.
ex.zh: 探险家们动身去征服新的领地了。

ex.en: The subject of artificial intelligence is unfamiliar territory for many traditional publishers.
ex.zh: 对许多传统出版商来说，人工智能是个陌生的领域。

senses: n. 惊恐，恐惧；恐怖，恐怖行动
terror.usage: 词组be a terror to sb.使某人恐惧;派生terrorism n.恐怖主义,恐怖行为；发音类似"太弱"→政府太软弱恐怖分子就猖狂；派生terrorist n.恐怖分子；索引p418

ex.en: These street gangs have become the terror of the neighbourhood.
ex.zh: 这些街头少年团伙使得周围邻里谈之色变。

ex.en: People fled the building in terror when the alarm sounded.
ex.zh: 警报响起时，人们惊恐地逃出大楼。

ex.en: The film tells the story of a family living under the terror of dictatorship.
ex.zh: 影片讲述了一个生活在独裁恐怖之下的家庭的故事。

ex.en: International cooperation is widely regarded as essential in the fight against terrorism.
ex.zh: 国际合作被普遍认为是打击恐怖主义的关键。

ex.en: After the terrorist attack, the government tightened security at all major transport hubs.
ex.zh: 恐怖袭击发生后，政府加强了所有主要交通枢纽的安保。

test.usage: 串词记忆：最好的(best)检验方式就是测试(test)；词根 test=witness 看到；索引p418

ex.en: All new drugs must pass rigorous safety tests before approval.
ex.zh: 所有新药在获批前都必须通过严格的安全测试。

ex.en: The long crisis was a real test of the government's competence.
ex.zh: 这场旷日持久的危机是对政府执政能力的一次真正考验。

ex.en: Doctors tested her blood for signs of infection.
ex.zh: 医生化验了她的血液，寻找感染的迹象。

testament.usage: test（证明）+ament→证明的东西→证据。搭配：be a testament to... 是……的证明

ex.en: The city's thriving art scene is a testament to decades of steady public investment.
ex.zh: 这座城市繁荣的艺术景象是数十年来持续公共投入的明证。

phrases.m: 作不利于/有利于某人的证言

testify.usage: [族] testimony n. 证词；test（证明）+ify→证明。近义：verify vt. 证实；辨析:justify提供合理理由以证明辩解;testify用证据或证词证明;verify指证实核实事物真实性;certify指官方或授权机构证明认证；v.作证；证明，证实；词根记忆：test(看到)+ify(动词后

ex.en: Anyone who has toiled through SAT will testify that test-taking skill also matters, whether it's knowing when to guess or what questions to skip.
ex.zh: 任何一个为SAT奋战过的人都可以证实，考试技巧也很重要，不管是知道何时靠猜测，还是哪些问题需要先跳过。

ex.en: She testified in court that she had seen the accident.
ex.zh: 她出庭作证说自己目击了事故。

ex.en: The former accountant will testify about the company's financial dealings before the committee.
ex.zh: 这位前会计师将就该公司的财务往来向委员会作证。

senses: n. 证据,证词;表明,说明
testimony.usage: testi（表示“证明”）+mony（发音类似“money，钱”）→证明是谁拿了钱→那就需要“证词”或“证据”。

ex.en: The witness's testimony contradicted what the defendant had told the police.
ex.zh: 证人的证词与被告对警方的陈述相矛盾。

ex.en: The ruins are a testimony to the city's rich history.
ex.zh: 这些遗迹见证了这座城市悠久的历史。

ex.en: The court heard testimony from more than twenty witnesses.
ex.zh: 法庭听取了二十多名证人的证词。

text.usage: n.正文；原文；课本；文本， 文章 v.发短信

ex.en: Read the text carefully before answering the questions.
ex.zh: 回答问题之前，请仔细阅读课文。

ex.en: The full text of the agreement will be published online.
ex.zh: 协议全文将在网上公布。

ex.en: She texted me to say the train was delayed.
ex.zh: 她给我发短信说火车晚点了。

ex.en: Her research design is a textbook example of how to control for bias.
ex.zh: 她的研究设计堪称控制偏差的教科书式范例。

textile.usage: 记：text(编织)+-ile(名后缀)→用毛线编织的物品→织物；[近]fabric/cloth n.织物；辨析:textile纺织品、纺织原料;fibre纤维;fabric织物、织品;texture物质的密度、质地

ex.en: The city grew rich on the textile trade in the nineteenth century.
ex.zh: 十九世纪，这座城市靠纺织品贸易致富。

ex.en: New tariffs on imported textiles have raised costs for local clothing makers.
ex.zh: 对进口纺织品征收新关税抬高了本地服装制造商的成本。

ex.en: foreign-made textiles
ex.zh: 外国制造的纺织品

ex.en: Close textual analysis reveals how the translator quietly reshaped the original meaning.
ex.zh: 细致的文本分析揭示了译者如何悄然重塑原意。

senses: n. (物体表面或物质的)质地,外观,肌理
n. 气质,性格,本质,特征

ex.en: The novel is admired for the rich texture of its descriptive passages.
ex.zh: 这部小说因其描写段落细腻丰富的质感而备受推崇。

ex.en: Thailand's tourism industry recovered rapidly once international travel restrictions were lifted.
ex.zh: 国际旅行限制解除后，泰国的旅游业迅速恢复。

ex.en: Households in the region now spend more on transport than on food.
ex.zh: 该地区家庭如今在交通上的支出超过了食品支出。

ex.en: We must thank the volunteers whose quiet efforts made the festival possible.
ex.zh: 我们必须感谢那些默默付出、使节日得以举办的志愿者。

ex.en: Residents were thankful that no one was injured in the late-night fire.
ex.zh: 居民们庆幸深夜那场火灾中无人受伤。

ex.en: Thanksgiving is traditionally a time when distant relatives gather for a large meal.
ex.zh: 感恩节传统上是远房亲戚团聚共享大餐的日子。

ex.en: The report warns that rising sea levels threaten coastal cities around the world.
ex.zh: 报告警告说，海平面上升正威胁着世界各地的沿海城市。

books.unit: 常见冠词、情态动词、系动词与限定词

senses: art. （指已提到或易领会到的人或事物）

ex.en: The internet has fundamentally changed how people access news and entertainment.
ex.zh: 互联网从根本上改变了人们获取新闻和娱乐的方式。

the arctic ocean.usage: 附录Ⅱ 大洋名；形容词 Arctic

ex.en: Melting ice in the Arctic Ocean is altering weather patterns far beyond the polar region.
ex.zh: 北冰洋的冰川融化正在改变远及极地以外地区的天气模式。

the atlantic ocean.usage: 附录Ⅱ 大洋名；形容词 Atlantic

ex.en: The Atlantic Ocean separates Europe and Africa from the continents of North and South America.
ex.zh: 大西洋把欧洲和非洲与南北美洲隔开。

ex.en: Monsoon winds over the Indian Ocean shaped trade routes for many centuries.
ex.zh: 几个世纪以来，印度洋上的季风一直决定着贸易航线的走向。

books.unit: 附录 I 部分国家(或地区)名称及相关信息

the netherlands.usage: adj. Dutch；人 Dutchman, Dutchwoman; the Dutch

ex.en: The Netherlands has invested heavily in flood-control systems to protect its low-lying land.
ex.zh: 荷兰在防洪系统上投入巨资，以保护其低洼国土。

the pacific ocean.usage: 附录Ⅱ 大洋名；形容词 Pacific

ex.en: The Pacific Ocean is the largest ocean on Earth, covering roughly a third of its surface.
ex.zh: 太平洋是地球上最大的海洋，约占地球表面的三分之一。

books.unit: 附录 I 部分国家(或地区)名称及相关信息

ex.en: The Philippines consists of more than seven thousand islands, many of them uninhabited.
ex.zh: 菲律宾由七千多个岛屿组成，其中许多岛屿无人居住。

books.unit: 附录 I 部分国家(或地区)名称及相关信息

ex.en: The Republic of Korea has become a global leader in semiconductor manufacturing.
ex.zh: 大韩民国已成为全球半导体制造业的领军者。

ex.en: The United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland is often shortened to the UK.
ex.zh: 大不列颠及北爱尔兰联合王国常被简称为英国。

senses: 观看戏剧或演出的地方

ex.en: The new theatre seats eight hundred people and hosts both plays and concerts.
ex.zh: 新剧院有八百个座位，既上演戏剧也举办音乐会。

ex.en: The restored theater now hosts concerts, film screenings, and experimental drama.
ex.zh: 修复后的剧院如今举办音乐会、电影放映和实验戏剧。

ex.en: Ticket prices at the local theatre were reduced to attract younger audiences.
ex.zh: 当地剧院降低了票价，以吸引更年轻的观众。

ex.en: His early plays were staged in small theatres before finally reaching the West End.
ex.zh: 他早期的戏剧先在小剧院上演，后来才终于登上伦敦西区的舞台。

ex.en: He was arrested for the theft of a car from a city car park.
ex.zh: 他因在市区停车场盗窃一辆汽车而被捕。

ex.en: The insurance policy does not cover theft of personal belongings.
ex.zh: 本保单不承保个人物品被盗。

ex.en: Police reported a sharp rise in bicycle thefts on campus.
ex.zh: 警方通报称，校园里自行车失窃案件急剧增加。

senses: det. 他们的；她们的；它们的

ex.en: Many graduates struggle to repay their student loans within the first five years.
ex.zh: 许多毕业生难以在最初五年内还清他们的学生贷款。

senses: pron. 他们的，她们的，它们的（所有物）

ex.en: Our apartment faces a quiet garden, while theirs overlooks a busy street.
ex.zh: 我们的公寓面向安静的花园，而他们的公寓则俯瞰热闹的街道。

ex.en: Scientists collected the water samples carefully and shipped them to the laboratory for analysis.
ex.zh: 科学家们小心采集水样，并将其运往实验室进行分析。

senses: n. (演讲、文章或艺术作品等的)主题，题目，中心思想(c)

ex.en: Hot temperatures were a common theme over the past couple of weeks.
ex.zh: 在过去的几周里，高温是一个常见的主题。

ex.en: Love and loss are recurring themes in her novels.
ex.zh: 爱与失去是她小说中反复出现的主题。

ex.en: This year's conference takes inequality as its central theme.
ex.zh: 今年的大会以不平等为中心议题。

senses: pron. 他们自己；她们自己；它们自己

ex.en: The villagers built the irrigation channel themselves, without any government assistance.
ex.zh: 村民们在没有任何政府援助的情况下自己修建了灌溉渠。

senses: ad. 当时；到那时；然后；那么；另外
adv. 那么,因而；然后,于是；另外
then.usage: 助记:then(当时)我在tent(帐篷)里;but then不过;now and then时而;and then而且,于是

ex.en: First the data are collected, and then they are cleaned and analysed.
ex.zh: 首先收集数据，然后再对数据进行清洗和分析。

ex.en: The debate soon moved from narrow theological questions to broader matters of public policy.
ex.zh: 辩论很快从狭义的神学问题转向更广泛的公共政策议题。

ex.en: Scientists rely on a theoretical model to predict how quickly the climate will change.
ex.zh: 科学家依靠理论模型来预测气候变化的速度。

theoretical.usage: adj.理论的；理论上的，假设的；索引p418

ex.en: The plan sounds perfect in theoretical terms but is hard to carry out.
ex.zh: 该计划理论上听上去完美，却很难实施。

ex.en: A solid grasp of theoretical physics is essential for this research position.
ex.zh: 扎实的理论物理功底对这一研究职位必不可少。

ex.en: The course combines theoretical knowledge with hands-on practice in the lab.
ex.zh: 这门课程将理论知识与实验室的实际操作相结合。

ex.en: Theoretically, the new policy should cut costs, though its actual effects remain unclear.
ex.zh: 理论上，新政策应该能降低成本，但其实际效果仍不明朗。

ex.en: It is easy to theorise about what motivates people, but far harder to measure it.
ex.zh: 对人的动机构建理论很容易，但要对其进行测量就难得多了。

senses: v. 建立理论(或学说);理论化;从理论上说明

ex.en: Rather than theorising endlessly, the researchers carried out a series of field experiments.
ex.zh: 研究人员没有无休止地空谈理论，而是进行了一系列实地实验。

ex.en: This is your chance to put theory into practice.
ex.zh: 这是你将理论付诸实践的机会。

ex.en: Darwin's theory of evolution changed the way people understand life on Earth.
ex.zh: 达尔文的进化论改变了人们理解地球上生命的方式。

ex.en: In theory, everyone has an equal chance, but in practice the gap remains wide.
ex.zh: 理论上人人机会均等，但实践中差距依然很大。

ex.en: A physical therapist designed a gentle exercise plan to ease her chronic back pain.
ex.zh: 理疗师为她设计了一套温和的运动计划，以缓解她的慢性背痛。

ex.en: They recommend exercise therapy for patients with chronic back pain.
ex.zh: 他们建议慢性背痛患者进行运动疗法。

ex.en: Physical therapy helped him walk again within six months.
ex.zh: 物理治疗帮助他在六个月内重新行走。

ex.en: She found group therapy helpful in coping with the loss of her son.
ex.zh: 她发现团体治疗有助于应对丧子之痛。

ex.en: There is growing evidence that regular exercise improves mental health.
ex.zh: 越来越多的证据表明，经常锻炼能改善心理健康。

thereafter.usage: there（那里）+after（之后）→此后。近义：afterwards ad. 以后

ex.en: The vaccine was licensed in the spring; thereafter, infections fell sharply within months.
ex.zh: 这种疫苗于春季获得许可；此后几个月内，感染人数急剧下降。

ex.en: The company cut costs, thereby increasing its profit margin.
ex.zh: 公司削减了成本，从而提高了利润率。

ex.en: She missed the deadline, thereby losing her chance to apply.
ex.zh: 她错过了截止日期，从而失去了申请的机会。

ex.en: Regular exercise lowers blood pressure, thereby reducing the risk of heart disease.
ex.zh: 经常锻炼可以降低血压，从而减少患心脏病的风险。

therefore.usage: thus 的近义词；adv.因此，所以

ex.en: The roads were flooded; therefore, the match was postponed.
ex.zh: 道路被淹，因此比赛被推迟。

ex.en: He is a minor, and therefore cannot sign the contract.
ex.zh: 他是未成年人，因此不能签署合同。

ex.en: Demand is rising while supply is fixed; prices will therefore continue to climb.
ex.zh: 需求上升而供应固定，因此价格将继续攀升。

ex.en: Birds ride thermal currents to gain height without flapping their wings.
ex.zh: 鸟类借助上升的热气流获得高度，而无需扇动翅膀。

ex.en: Nurses checked the patient's temperature with a digital thermometer every four hours.
ex.zh: 护士每四小时用电子体温计测一次病人的体温。

senses: n. 自动调温器,恒温器

ex.en: A programmable thermostat can cut heating bills by adjusting the temperature automatically.
ex.zh: 可编程恒温器能够自动调节温度，从而减少取暖费用。

ex.en: These findings challenge the long-held assumption that older workers adapt slowly to change.
ex.zh: 这些发现挑战了年长员工适应变化缓慢这一长期存在的假设。

thesis.usage: 记：本身为词根，意为“放置”→放置论点论证的文章→论文；复数theses；[近]paper n.论文；dissertation n.学位论文；辨析:thesis多指毕业/学位论文;termpaper指学期论文;dissertation篇幅最长,学术含量高,多指专题论文

ex.en: She spent two years collecting data for her doctoral thesis.
ex.zh: 她花了两年时间为博士论文收集数据。

ex.en: The essay's central thesis is that technology widens social inequality.
ex.zh: 这篇文章的中心论点是技术加剧了社会不平等。

ex.en: Critics have questioned the thesis that economic growth automatically reduces poverty.
ex.zh: 批评者对“经济增长必然减少贫困”这一论点提出质疑。

senses: pron. 他们；她们；它们；（泛指）人们，人人

ex.en: Consumers say they want greener products, yet price still drives most purchases.
ex.zh: 消费者说他们想要更环保的产品，但价格仍决定着大多数购买行为。

ex.en: Thick fog settled over the valley, forcing drivers to slow to a crawl.
ex.zh: 浓雾笼罩山谷，迫使司机把车开得极慢。

ex.en: Security cameras caught the thief slipping the small painting under his coat.
ex.zh: 监控摄像头拍到小偷把那幅小画藏进外套里。

ex.en: The runner pulled a muscle in his thigh during the final lap of the race.
ex.zh: 这名跑步者在比赛的最后一圈拉伤了大腿肌肉。

ex.en: The ice on the lake was too thin to support the skaters.
ex.zh: 湖面的冰太薄，承受不住滑冰者的重量。

ex.en: Patience, it turns out, is the most valuable thing in any difficult negotiation.
ex.zh: 事实证明，耐心是任何艰难谈判中最宝贵的东西。

senses: vt.&vi. 想；思考；思索；认为；以为

ex.en: Historians think the manuscript dates from the early fifteenth century.
ex.zh: 历史学家认为这份手稿可以追溯到十五世纪早期。

ex.en: A leading think-tank has warned that housing costs in major cities will continue to rise.
ex.zh: 一家知名智库警告说，大城市的住房成本将继续上涨。

ex.en: Fashion magazines have long been criticised for glorifying extreme thinness.
ex.zh: 时尚杂志长期以来因美化极度瘦削而受到批评。

ex.en: Roughly a third of the city's household waste is now recycled.
ex.zh: 如今该市大约三分之一的生活垃圾得到回收利用。

thirst.usage: 同义:hunger,desire;派生:thirsty adj.渴的,渴望的

ex.en: A burning thirst drove the travellers to the oasis on the far side of the dunes.
ex.zh: 难耐的干渴驱使旅人奔向沙丘那边的绿洲。

senses: a. 渴望的；渴的；干旱的

ex.en: Readers thirsty for reliable information often turn to quality newspapers rather than social media feeds.
ex.zh: 渴望可靠信息的读者常常求助于优质报纸，而非社交媒体的信息流。

ex.en: At thirteen, he had already taught himself to repair radios.
ex.zh: 十三岁时他就已自学了修理收音机。

ex.en: Nearly thirty percent of the respondents admitted they rarely read books after graduation.
ex.zh: 近百分之三十的受访者承认毕业后很少读书。

ex.en: This finding challenges the widespread assumption that money alone brings happiness.
ex.zh: 这一发现挑战了金钱本身能带来幸福这一普遍假设。

senses: n. 使人生气(或苦恼)的事(或人)

ex.en: The issue of rising house prices remains a thorn in the government's side.
ex.zh: 房价上涨问题始终是政府的心头之刺。

thorough.usage: 近义：complete a. 完全的；派生:thoroughly adv.彻底地,充分地；发音类似“仨肉”→盘子里就仨肉，被你吃完了→完全的，彻底的。

ex.en: You will need a thorough understanding of the subject.
ex.zh: 你需要对这个学科有透彻的了解。

ex.en: The police carried out a thorough investigation of the accident.
ex.zh: 警方对事故进行了彻底调查。

ex.en: She is thorough in everything she does, down to the smallest detail.
ex.zh: 她做什么都很细致，连最小的细节也不放过。

senses: adv. 非常；彻底地；仔细地

ex.en: The most thoroughly studied intellectuals in the history of the New World are the ministers and political leaders of seventeenth-century New England.
ex.zh: 在新大陆的历史中，被研究得最彻底的学者是17世纪新英格兰的牧师和政治领袖们。

ex.en: Those who exercise regularly tend to cope better with workplace stress.
ex.zh: 经常锻炼的人往往更能应对职场压力。

senses: conj. 虽然；尽管；可是，然而

ex.en: Though the experiment failed twice, the researchers refused to abandon it.
ex.zh: 尽管实验失败了两次，研究人员仍拒绝放弃。

senses: n. [U] 考虑；思维（thoughts）[pl.] 心思
thought.usage: on second thoughts 经重新考虑,一转念

ex.en: The thought of failing the exam kept him awake all night.
ex.zh: 一想到考试不及格，他就彻夜难眠。

ex.en: Ancient Greek thought has shaped Western philosophy for centuries.
ex.zh: 古希腊思想数百年来一直塑造着西方哲学。

ex.en: She sat in silence, lost in thought.
ex.zh: 她默默地坐着，陷入了沉思。

senses: adj. 认真思考的,沉思的,有心事的
thoughtful.usage: 派生:thoughtfully adv.周到地;thoughtfulness n.周到；adj.深思熟虑的；沉思的；体贴的

ex.en: It was thoughtful of you to send flowers to the hospital.
ex.zh: 你给医院送花，想得真周到。

ex.en: He gave a thoughtful reply after considering the question carefully.
ex.zh: 仔细考虑这个问题后，他给出了深思熟虑的回答。

ex.en: She wore a thoughtful expression as she read the letter.
ex.zh: 读信时，她脸上带着若有所思的神情。

senses: adj. 粗心大意的;欠考虑的;轻率的
thoughtless.usage: adj.粗心大意的，欠考虑的；索引p418

ex.en: It was thoughtless of him to leave the door open in such cold weather.
ex.zh: 天这么冷他还让门开着，真是欠考虑。

ex.en: A thoughtless remark can hurt a friend more than an insult.
ex.zh: 一句轻率的话对朋友的伤害可能比辱骂更深。

ex.en: Thoughtless tourists leave litter along the mountain paths.
ex.zh: 粗心大意的游客把垃圾丢在山路上。

ex.en: More than a thousand workers signed the petition against the factory's closure.
ex.zh: 一千多名工人在反对工厂关闭的请愿书上签了名。

senses: n. 思绪,思路;螺纹,(唱片的)纹,槽
vt. 穿(针、线等);穿过,通过
thread.usage: 助记:我的thread(思路)是threat(恐吓)敌人；索引p418

ex.en: She threaded the needle and began to sew the torn seam.
ex.zh: 她穿好针线，开始缝补裂开的接缝。

ex.en: The journalist followed every thread of the corruption story.
ex.zh: 记者追查这桩腐败案的每一条线索。

ex.en: He lost the thread of the argument and asked the speaker to repeat.
ex.zh: 他跟不上论证的思路，请发言人再讲一遍。

senses: n. 恐吓，威胁；凶兆；构成威胁的人（或事物）
threat.usage: 另：in the face of a serious threat面临严重的威胁；crack down on threats减少威胁；the coming threats即将面临的威胁；索引p418

ex.en: Scientists in one wave after another try to awaken us to the growing threat of global warming.
ex.zh: 科学家们前赴后继地试图唤醒我们要认清全球变暖正在带来日益严重的威胁。

ex.en: Rising sea levels pose a direct threat to island communities whose homes lie barely above the water.
ex.zh: 海平面上升对家园仅高出水面一点点的岛屿社区构成直接威胁。

ex.en: The company sees cheap imports not as a threat but as a chance to improve efficiency.
ex.zh: 这家公司不把廉价进口视为威胁，而是将其视为提高效率的契机。

senses: v. 恐吓，威胁；预示凶兆；有……危险

phrases.p: threaten to widen the gap between A and B
phrases.m: 可能会加大A与B之间的差距

threaten.usage: 【记】环境污染正危及（threaten）地球上的生物，这是一种日益严重的威胁（threat）。；派生:threateningly adv.威胁地,胁迫地；v.威胁，恐吓；危及；索引p418

ex.en: The crash was a major reason the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service (USFWS) decided to formally list the bird as threatened.
ex.zh: 这种鸟的数量锐减是美国鱼类和野生动物管理局(USFWS)决定正式将其列为受威胁物种的主要原因。

ex.en: Even as we humans count on forests to soak up a good share of the carbon dioxide we produce, we are threatening their ability to do so.
ex.zh: 即使是在我们人类指望森林吸收我们产生的大部分二氧化碳的同时，我们也在对森林吸收二氧化碳的能力造成威胁。

ex.en: Rapid urban development threatens the wetlands that thousands of migrating birds depend on.
ex.zh: 快速的城市开发正威胁着数以千计候鸟赖以生存的湿地。

ex.en: Conservationists are working to save threatened species from extinction.
ex.zh: 自然保护工作者正努力拯救受威胁的物种，使其免于灭绝。

ex.en: Under a dark and threatening sky, the organisers decided to postpone the open-air concert.
ex.zh: 天色阴沉、雷雨将至，组织者决定推迟这场露天音乐会。

ex.en: The committee gave us three weeks to revise the proposal.
ex.zh: 委员会给了我们三周时间修改提案。

threshold.usage: 助记:thresh(脱粒,打谷麦)+old(古老的)→古老的打麦方法都是在门槛上→门槛；索引p418

ex.en: She paused on the threshold of the old house before knocking.
ex.zh: 她在老屋门口停顿了一下，然后敲了门。

ex.en: The income threshold for paying tax has risen this year.
ex.zh: 今年的纳税收入起征点提高了。

ex.en: The country stands on the threshold of a new economic era.
ex.zh: 这个国家正站在新经济时代的起点上。

ex.en: We should oppose extravagant eating and drinking and pay attention to thrift and economy.
ex.zh: 我们应该反对大吃大喝并注意节俭。

ex.en: Raised in a poor family, she learned the virtue of thrift early.
ex.zh: 由于在贫困家庭长大，她很早就懂得了节俭的美德。

ex.en: Thrift encouraged by the government helped the country through the financial crisis.
ex.zh: 政府提倡的节约帮助这个国家渡过了金融危机。

ex.en: Having lived through hard times, the older generation's thriftiness shaped their spending habits.
ex.zh: 经历过艰难岁月，老一辈的节俭塑造了他们的消费习惯。

senses: v. 使非常兴奋,使非常激动
n. 震颤感；兴奋感；兴奋；激动；令人兴奋的经历
v. 使非常兴奋；使非常激动
thrill.usage: thr（想象成three“三个”）+ill（想象成hill“山”）→三个人登上了山顶，感到非常“激动”。；索引p418

ex.en: It gave me a big thrill to meet my favourite author in person.
ex.zh: 能见到我最喜欢的作者本人，我感到兴奋不已。

ex.en: Nothing matches the thrill of crossing the finish line first.
ex.zh: 没有什么能比得上第一个冲过终点线的那种兴奋。

ex.en: The audience were thrilled by the magician's breathtaking performance.
ex.zh: 魔术师惊险的表演令观众兴奋不已。
